note: Open upstream issues that explain an oracle expectation wallet-backend does not meet. A failing oracle check that matches a rule is labelled with the issue; one that matches none is reported as unexplained, which is a candidate new finding. Rules match on the expected row and on where the oracle saw the change; they never hide a failure.

rules.title: An XLM transfer through the native asset contract that creates the destination account gets no ACCOUNT CREATE state change
Contract deployments that no auth entry declares get no ACCOUNT CREATE state change (factory deploys, Stellar Asset Contracts)
A pre-authorized transaction signer that core removes in txChangesBefore never gets a SIGNER REMOVE state change
A pool-share trustline removed by an authorization revocation gets no TRUSTLINE REMOVE state change
